intent: A restrained, token-based gradient fill for one rare heading (a docs hero, an empty-state title). Real text, never an image; no motion.
useWhen: one hero or empty-state heading per view
a marketing or docs headline that needs a touch of brand
doNotUseWhen: body copy, labels, buttons or data
more than one heading per view
status or meaning — use Badge or status text

tone.note: ink: text.fg → text.brand; brand: text.brand → primary.fg. Paper's overlay (brand → violet) waits for the violet role decision.

motion.note: None. Paper's optional hue shift is not built (Boris).

requirements: real text, selectable and read as written
both gradient ends keep ≥ 4.5:1 against their surface
solid text.fg (CanvasText) under forced colours; solid text.fg where background-clip: text is unsupported

doNot: Do not render it as an image
Do not add a colour ramp or hex stops
